name: gauge
description: A partial-arc gauge with an open bottom, similar to a speedometer. Best suited for CPU and GPU usage.

config.name: metric
config.label: Metric
config.description: The metric to visualize on the gauge arc.

config.name: max
config.label: Max Value
config.description: The maximum value the gauge represents. The needle reaches the far end when the metric equals this value.

config.name: precision
config.label: Precision
config.description: The number of decimal places shown for the metric value displayed inside the gauge.

config.name: font_family
config.label: Font Family
config.description: The font used for the value and label text rendered inside the gauge.

config.name: font_color
config.label: Font Color
config.description: The color of the value and label text rendered inside the gauge.

config.name: label
config.label: Label
config.description: A custom label displayed below the value inside the gauge. Defaults to the metric name if left empty.

config.name: hide_label
config.label: Hide Label
config.description: When checked, the label text inside the gauge is hidden.

config.name: hide_unit
config.label: Hide Unit
config.description: When checked, the unit suffix of the metric value is hidden.

config.name: color
config.label: Front Color
config.description: The color of the filled gauge arc under normal conditions.

config.name: back_color
config.label: Back Color
config.description: The color of the unfilled portion of the gauge arc.

config.name: warning_threshold
config.label: Threshold (%)
config.description: The percentage of the max value at which the gauge arc switches to the warning color.

config.name: warning_color
config.label: Color
config.description: The arc color used when the metric exceeds the warning threshold.

config.name: critical_threshold
config.label: Threshold (%)
config.description: The percentage of the max value at which the gauge arc switches to the critical color.

config.name: critical_color
config.label: Color
config.description: The arc color used when the metric exceeds the critical threshold.
